title: UI preview workflow: a labeled event may only start notify/build when the added label is ui-preview; gate both jobs together
answers: Why does adding an unrelated label to a PR trigger a UI preview build or comment?
Why does the UI preview notify job run when I add a label that is not ui-preview?
Which jobs in the UI preview workflow decide whether a PR event triggers a preview?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/ui-preview.yml, the `notify` and `build` jobs' `if:` conditions. These gate which pull_request events (opened, synchronize, labeled, etc.) start a UI preview for a PR whose labels include `ui-preview` and whose author is OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR or the Copilot bot.
Rule: For `labeled` actions, require `github.event.label.name == 'ui-preview'` in addition to the existing label-presence check. Any gate change to the preview trigger must be applied to both `notify` and `build` jobs together, and mirrored in the workflow-level concurrency group so the same events are treated as relevant there.
Symptom: Adding an unrelated label to a PR that already had `ui-preview` re-ran the preview notify/build steps, causing redundant deployments.
Constraints: Only the `labeled` action is narrowed; other actions still rely on the presence of `ui-preview` in the PR's labels. Does not apply to the `closed` cleanup path, which is excluded by `action != 'closed'`.
applies: Job-level trigger conditions of the UI Preview workflow in .github/workflows/ui-preview.yml.
says: Adding an unrelated tag to a pull request triggers an unnecessary preview deployment.
The preview bot posts notifications whenever any label is attached to a pull request.
Only build and launch the interface preview when the preview label itself is added.
Stop re-running interface preview builds when team members add triage or documentation labels.
Pull requests with existing previews experience redundant build cycles when adding routine tags.
search: In .github/workflows/ui-preview.yml, the notify and build jobs' if: conditions for labeled pull_request events must specifically check github.event.label.name == 'ui-preview' in addition to verifying the label's presence. Any trigger gating changes must be applied to both notify and build jobs simultaneously and mirrored in the workflow concurrency group to avoid redundant preview deployments. This restriction applies strictly to labeled actions, leaving other PR actions (like opened or synchronize) and the closed cleanup path unchanged.
